system.description: Entering the Panoply, spend 1 Fabula Point to invoke your Theme: +5 entry damage, and until the form ends — Immunity to your element; your element's damage-bypass clause works as printed; and once per Check, 10 MP to reroll either or both dice, non-fumble. Once per rest. The Immunity stands, ruled as the campaign's one sanctioned transcendent state: unlike Pulse of the Maggots it is once per rest, Theme-invoked, Fabula-priced and form-scoped — a climax, not a statblock.
